nom: Naked Sundays CabanaMilk Mineral Barrier Fluid SPF 50

avis.texte: I was excited and wanted to love this SPF! I found it a bit too greasy/shiny on application. Perhaps more bothersome, however, was the eye sting.

I have medium oily/combination skin and this product just enhanced that oil. The sunscreen itself did not break me out which is a plus, but it is so greasy. You can just feel this on your skin. Would only recommend if you have dry skin.

avis.titre: LOVE Naked Sundays but this was returned
avis.texte: Naked Sundays made a mineral SPF that doesn't make me look like a ghost and so I wanted to try this one too! they discontinued the first spf I use and the replacement formula stains my clothes so I got this one as soon as it came out. It feels very lightweight but has a really bad smell. I may have received a one off but I cannot wear it. this formula doesn't transfer or stain my clothes so I was pretty bummed that the smell was so off putting.

I love this sunscreen! My typical foundation shade category is light neutral and it sheers out to a really beautiful, hydrated, skin-like base. It sits so nicely under makeup. I will rave about the sunscreen itself forever. I HATE the packaging. I hate the squeezy applicator, I hate that it has to balance on a skinny little lid if you want to attempt to leave it upright, I hate how plastic and flimsy and cheap it feels for something so pricy. Give the people a cylindrical bottle with an air pump. As someone who plans to repurchase regardless, I beg for a packaging redesign.

I regularly use quite a few of their products from their foundation tint, both of their SPF sprays, both versions of the cabana clear and their glow serum blush and bronzers so I was excited when this came out. I debated on buying it because I have so much sunscreen as it is but I am glad that I did. it's a perfect mineral sunscreen for under makeup or to wear just on its own. I have combo skin with an oily tzone so when I wear it on its own I set it with just a very thin layer of loose setting powder and it holds up great. It has become one of the main ones I reach for over the last few weeks and for me personally, while it is a tiny bit of a thicker consistency (not much) it gives me the same feel and coverage as the tatcha silk and the Ultra Violette future screen. This will definitely continue to be a regular repurchase for me!!

I love this brand and wanted to love this product but it was too oily for my skin type. I love that the color matched perfectly, no white cast, and the serum texture is so easy to put on but couldnt do it with my oily skin. Might work of you used primer. But I think this is overall better for drier skin types
Lightweight, blendable, nice glowing coverage, but it smells absolutely awful like burnt skin or something.

avis.titre: Wasn't sure at first but now it's my daily spf!
avis.texte: BIG FAN of this sunscreen! While it feels greasy when first applying, it dries pretty quickly, is lightweight, and has a subtle scent. It doesn't dry out my sensitive, acne-prone skin, and is incredibly hydrating, like a skincare step. No breakouts or sensitivity! Ordering another bottle!

I've tried a lot of mineral sunscreens, and this one really surprised me. The texture is lightweight and fluid, making it easy to apply without the thick, chalky feel I usually expect. It blends in quickly, leaves my skin looking smooth, and sits beautifully under makeup. I also noticed my skin stayed hydrated throughout the day without feeling greasy. Most importantly, it didn't irritate my sensitive skin or leave a noticeable white cast. It's become an easy addition to my daily routine and one I actually look forward to using every morning. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Finally spf i reach out for
avis.texte: I've tried a lot of mineral sunscreens, and most of them end up feeling heavy or leave a noticeable cast. This one was a pleasant surprise. It feels lightweight, blends in easily, and leaves my skin looking healthy and hydrated. I love that it doesn't feel greasy throughout the day and sits nicely under makeup. I've been reaching for it every morning without even thinking about it, which says a lot. Definitely one of the more comfortable mineral SPFs I've used. Thank you for this spf *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have turned into quite a connoisseur of sunscreen (especially tinted sunscreen) since I have been trying to treat my skin while also preventing further damage. I've found that most tinted sunscreens I've used either have too much pigment, are too oily, or have some sort of chemical component that stings my eyes. This new CabanaMilk Mineral Barrier Fluid not only has the SPF that I'm looking for (at least SPF 50 for my face), but it blends in beautifully, is not too heavy, and is odorless. I love this! It feels more like skincare while also protecting and evening my skin tone. Definitely love the lightweight feel too. I will be a repeat buyer for this one! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This is one of my new favorite sunscreens to wear. I specifically look for mineral sunscreens and its hard to find ones that aren't super heavy and leave a white cast that also have a higher spf. This one checks all the boxes! It's really lightweight, has a tint so it doesn't leave any white cast, and works well under makeup. I usually apply and let it sink in for a few minutes before applying my makeup and its perfect. I wish it didn't have the chemical boosters in it but thats even harder to find so I'll take it for now. I recieved this product as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been really impressed with this SPF! The formula feels lightweight and blends into the skin easily without leaving a heavy or greasy feeling. As someone who prefers mineral sunscreens, I love that it provides broad-spectrum protection while still feeling comfortable enough for daily use. It layers well under makeup, doesn't pill, and gives my skin a natural, healthy finish. I also appreciate that it doesn't leave a noticeable white cast. Overall, this is a great option if you're looking for a mineral sunscreen that feels skincare-like and easy to wear every day. Highly recommend! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This mineral barrier feels so smooth on the scheme. It adds a bit of a glow as well, and of course, protects your skin from the damaging you'll be right, what else can you ask for?The texture is great and application is easy. And if he has SPF 50! And the best thing is that it doesn't feel sticky on the skin.I received this product for free and this is my honest opinion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I like the sheer tint of this sunscreen. It applies like a foundation kinda. It gives my skin a shiny glow until I apply makeup over it. Makeup went over it good & stayed most the day. It didn't over dry my skin or make it oily. I was in & out of the sun quite a bit & got no redness. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This is the first year I've really decided to use sunscreen regularly. I have melasma, so I require a tinted mineral sunscreen. This is the first one I've tried that is tinted but doesn't make me look orange. There's no scent. It's nice and thin and weightless. It even helps repair the skin barrier! I have acne-prone skin and have only noticed a single spot pop up when I didn't wash it off at the end of the day. I did knock a star off because it does get kind of oily, gritty feeling towards the end of the day. But it's the best sunscreen I've found so far! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Absolutely obsessed with the CabanaMilk Mineral Barrier Fluid SPF50. It blends in so smoothly for a mineral sunscreen — no heavy feeling, no greasy finish, and barely any white cast. My skin feels protected, hydrated, and actually looks better when I wear it. It layers perfectly under makeup and doesn't pill throughout the day. Definitely one of the best SPF products I've tried and 100% worth the hype! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've been using the Naked Sundays CabanaMilk Barrier Fluid SPF 50 and I'm obsessed! It feels more like skincare than sunscreen! The formula is lightweight, hydrating, and leaves my skin looking fresh and dewy without feeling greasy!!! I love that it helps support my skin barrier while giving broad spectrum SPF 50 protection! It layers beautifully under makeup and doesn't leave a white cast, which is always a win! Love this product and can't wait to share with my friends and family. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I received this as a part of an educational promotion. I tried the tinted sunscreen for two weeks and it's now a part of my everyday routine. I had used a different tinted sunscreen and it made my skin feel dry and flaky. This one is so hydrating, and leaves my skin feeling moisturized and glowy. I've tried applying with my hands and a brush and I prefer applying this with a brush for more coverage since it's a bit sheer. Color wise I feel like the tint has a perfect neutral shade. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have very sensitive eyes and very sensitive skin, but I also have very pale skin, so finding something that works as a skin tint that doesn't bother my eyes and doesn't bother my skin is always a feet. However, I truly enjoyed this product. I like that it can be worn alone and covers a little bit of my redness while making me feel protective from the sun, but also can be worn underneath a full face of foundation and not pill or disturb the products that I put on top. I only took away one star just because upon initial application it did make my eyes a little watery, but it didn't sting so that's a benefit. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I had to keep in mind while using this that it's just a skin tint and it wouldn't be super full coverage. One thing that I love about this is that it's very glowy and dewy. This makes my skin look much healthier and radiant which I love a lot. I used this to do my no makeup makeup look and it looked amazing. I had no problem with concealer and other makeup products going on top of the sunscreen which I really appreciate. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I got to try The Naked Sundays cabana milk mineral barrier fluid. The barrier fluid is hydrating and has a light tint. To be honest, I barely notice a tint at all. I was surprised because when it came out of the bottle I was actually concerned it would be too dark for my skin, as I am fair skinned but it worked well for me. When I applied the barrier fluid to my skin, it did not pill which is a plus for me! It is lightweight and kind of the perfect addition to a beach day. I have combination skin and I will say this is great for dry or combo skin, but it doesn't make you shiny, so if you have oily skin this may not be a product for you. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

While I understand the benefits of using SPF I'II admit I'm not consistent with using it mainly because of the smell of SPF until I tried cabana milk. This product is SPF 50 but has none of that typical smell and something that I have been using daily to give my face protection against anti aging. The product is tinted, although I didn't see anv color pavoff once blended into mv skin so I feel like this is safe for a variety of different skin tones. I used makeup on top of it and it blended and did not affect application so if you're looking for a daily SPF definitely check this one out if you're sensitive to smells! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I am very satisfied with this fluid. It has a light texture, it goes well on the skin. It does not weigh down, does not clog pores. The plus is that it has a light tone, which looks quite nice on the skin and evens out minor irregularities. So I really recommend it *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This felt so lightweight on my skin when I tell you I am obsessed. I honestly forgot I was wearing SPF. The tint is very light. It's not noticeable, and it did not leave a cast when blending in my skin did not feel greasy at all. I honestly wore it the other day to a baseball game where I knew I was gonna be in the sun for hours I did reapply the SPF just to be safe but overall this is going in my summer bag *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Overall, I really love this product!First of all, the packaging is amazing—it looks so stylish. Secondly, the texture is incredible. When I apply it to my face, it feels like I have absolutely nothing on, even though I do.Thirdly, the SPF protection is the real deal. It actually works! When I was at the beach, I forgot to put sunscreen on my body, and I got sunburned—but my face was completely fine.Just a heads-up: if you're looking for a heavy tint, this might not be it. It gives a very subtle, light tint, so it's not super noticeable. But it leaves the skin looking so hydrated and glowy, which is exactly what I was looking for. I absolutely love it and will definitely keep using it. But again, if you want an SPF with a more intense color payoff, this might not be for you.The milk itself is great—it feels so nice, absorbs easily, and leaves absolutely no greasy residue. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: That Healthy Skin Glow in a Bottle!
avis.texte: If you want to look like a fresh faced, glowing, healthy skin baddie, CabanaMilk is for you! The consistency is nice and thin, very easy to blend out and not greasy at all. It absorbs into the skin quickly and gives an absolutely gorgeous "lit from within" type of glow to your skin. It's truly stunning and offers just enough tint to even out your skin tone a bit. It truly is healthy glowy skin in a bottle. It works beautifully alone and layers well under makeup, just let it dry down a bit. It doesn't really have a scent which is nice, because I hate the classic sunscreen smell. I would definitely prefer to use this over a regular facial sunscreen as it isn't greasy and doesn't leave any sort of white cast to the skin. Overall this is a great product, especially for those who love to glow and pull off the "no-makeup makeup" look! Would recommend to anyone of any age. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I've tried a lot of SPF products, but Naked Sundays CabanaMilk Mineral Barrier Fluid SPF 50 has quickly become one of my favorites. The formula feels incredibly hydrating and comfortable on my skin throughout the day without feeling heavy or greasy. It blends in beautifully for a mineral sunscreen and leaves my complexion looking smooth, healthy, and radiant.What impressed me most was the flawless finish it gave my skin. It almost works like a skin-perfecting primer, creating the perfect base for makeup while still providing excellent sun protection. My skin looked hydrated, even-toned, and glowing all day. If you're looking for a mineral SPF that feels nourishing and leaves your skin looking amazing, I highly recommend giving this one a try! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I'm really loving this Cabana Milk Tinted SPF! I've been using it for a few days now during the day when I go out, and I've had a great experience with it. It's easy to apply and goes in very smoothly and evenly. It has minimal scent and isn't offensive in any way. I decided to not wear it with makeup and it gave my skin a really nice glow! It didn't irritate my skin or make it flare up at all either. I loved that it didn't feel cakey like other SPFs can do as well. This will absolutely be a new part of my getting ready routine! *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I will preface this by saying I struggle finding SPF that I can/will wear and now that is no longer a worry. I don't like the way a lot of sunscreens feel and have experienced irritation with some. Well not with this. I had no irritation and in fact it has calming ingredients. More importantly I liked the way this felt on my skin. The texture is nice and not too thick. It felt hydrating. It was comfortable to wear. It looked great under makeup but also on its own. There is a light but pleasant scent. This product quickly made its way into my regular routine. If you are looking for a lightweight SPF to fit into your routine you should definitely give this a try. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I liked the Mineral Barrier Fluid SPF50 by Naked Sundays. My makeup looks good when I first apply and sets pretty well. However, the heat in the southern area where I live is very hot. I give it grace because of that reason. I do like it as an SPF for my face just on its own. It has a tint but it's sheer. I wear it when I want a little color but not too much. It does feel a little more soothing than some SPF primers I've tried. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I have loved naked Sundays since day 1. Ive tried out quite a few products from them. I was so excited when I was chosen for this round to try out a new unreleased product. I was out of town for 1 week straight and used this product most of the time on my vacation with and without wearing any makeup since my skin was horribly breaking out with cystic acne for the first time ever which was hard to control. Instead of packing on makeup on my cystic acne breakouts I decided just go wash my face and apply this beautiful dewy primer SPF. I thought maybe after the first time trying this product it's what caused my cystic acne breakouts which was so accurate for me. This lotion was tinted which I loved as well but it was extremely oily for me too. Skincare products which contain more oil are known to cause breakouts. I know this because of common knowledge and I just graduated medical esthetics school. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I've really enjoyed using the Naked Sundays CabanaMilk Mineral Barrier Fluid SPF 50. The formula feels lightweight and comfortable on the skin, absorbs well, and doesn't leave my face feeling greasy throughout the day. I also appreciate that it provides high SPF protection while still feeling breathable and easy to wear daily. It has a light tint, which helps even out my skin tone without looking heavy or artificial.It layers nicely under makeup and doesn't pill, which is a huge plus for me. My skin feels hydrated and protected, and I love that it doesn't leave a noticeable white cast like some mineral sunscreens can. Overall, this is a great everyday SPF that combines sun protection with a comfortable, skin-friendly formula. I would definitely recommend it and would happily use it again. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I received the CabanaMilk as a part of an educational promotion. I have really been enjoying the CabanaMilk SPF. It is tinted so there is no white cast and it blends in easily. It does feel a little greasy at first but once it sets you are left with a very pretty natural looking glow. It worked very well under my makeup and on top of my other skin care products. I had no pilling at all. I would absolutely repurchase this. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: A Solid SPF that also Delivers Skincare Results
avis.texte: I have had the pleasure of testing out this Naked Sundays CabanaMilk Mineral Barrier Fluid SPF 50 while on vacation in northern California. I needed a high SPF formula that delivered long lasting results and did not add additional greasiness/oiliness to my already oily face. I'm very fair skinned and burn very easily. I appreciated the skincare ingredients added to this SPF formula to help keep the integrity of my skin barrier and added moisture to my skin as well. The glowy finish was not something I perfer-I tend to go for matte formulas. Aside from that, I thought this primer did a great job of protecting my skin from the harmful sun's rays. I did not have any sunburned skin on my face, neck, and upper chest where I applied this product, and that stayed true to the numerous days that I used and tested it out. I thought this product was a bit pricey for only the 1.35 fl. oz. in this bottle. I know I will be going through this SPF formula pretty quickly with how often I need sun protection. I think this is a great primer and it worked well paired with all of my face makeup and after a long day of walking and hiking it heald up well at the end of the day. I still required some makeup touchups here and there but that is very normal for me and my oily skin. I appreciate this is sensitive skin friendly as well as I can sometimes have some trouble with redness and sensitivity to my facial skin. And as an added bonus the primer is tinted and I really appreciated the added complexi

I have been loving this! It works amazingly as a primer under my makeup. It instantly hydrates my skin, and my makeup literally glides on. I especially love this as someone with combination – dry skin. On no-makeup days, I love wearing it on its own because it gives my skin such a glow without looking oily or greasy. I have also not had any issues with breakouts, even with my acne prone skin! I am obsessed with the packaging, and it is so easy to toss in my bag for reapplication throughout the day. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I had no idea this product was tinted - and then thought, "What if it's not my shade!" This is my first time using a tinted SPF, so I honestly had no idea what to expect. I totally thought it would probably just make me look orange. I have very fair skin with rosy undertones, so I wasn't sure with a product with one shade option if it would work for me at all!The first thing I noticed with this product was how thin the consistency of the product is. It's not watery, but it's certainly not heavy either. Buildable for sure!The product went on very nicely on the skin, did not cake or peel at all. I was able to build up more product on my face as I wasn't sure how much to use initially, so I was able to add more as I saw fit - with no heavy or greasy feeling. The product blended in with just my hands, and the tone looked even & it blended in so well with my skin color! It left my skin feeling soft and looking glowy and radiant. It just helped my complexion look more even - without looking like I have a heavy foundation on. A very natural looking glow!The only thing I noticed is that it's a little heavy on the glow. It made my t zone look a little too shiny, which I was a little concerned about - I don't want to look greasy or like I'm sweating! I think I'll use a pore primer first on my skin to make my skin look a little more matte like, then I'll go in with this tinted SPF next to combat the extreme glow! Overall, I think this product would work best for those with normal to dry

I don't usually get emotionally attached to sunscreen… but here we are. Naked Sundays CabanaMilk Mineral Barrier Fluid SPF 50 has completely changed my relationship with mineral SPF, and honestly? I'm wondering where this has been all my life.First off, let's talk texture because mineral sunscreens and I have had beef in the past. Usually, they're thick, chalky, dramatic, and leave me looking like I accidentally powdered myself with flour. But CabanaMilk? She's smooth, lightweight, and glides on like a dreamy skincare serum. No heavy feeling, no weird greasy aftermath, and best of all — NO ghost face. As someone who wears makeup regularly, this layers beautifully underneath without pilling or making me look like my foundation is fighting for survival.The finish is gorgeous — healthy, glowy, but not "I just ran a marathon" shiny. My skin actually feels protected and nourished, not smothered. I've worn it on busy days, sunny errands, and even under full makeup, and it stays feeling comfortable all day.Can we also appreciate an SPF 50 mineral formula that doesn't make sunscreen feel like a chore? It feels luxe, effortless, and gives serious "vacation skin in a bottle" energy. The name CabanaMilk is oddly perfect because it genuinely feels like something your skin would sip poolside in a tiny sunhat.If you've been traumatized by old-school mineral sunscreens, consider this your healing era. Naked Sundays absolutely nailed it with this one. Five stars, zero regrets, and yes — I wi

I am seriously HOOKED … I've been using the Naked Sundays CabanaMilk Mineral Barrier Fluid SPF 50, and it has quickly become one of my favorite sunscreens. The lightweight formula feels comfortable on my skin and blends in easily without feeling heavy. I love that it provides SPF 50 protection while also helping to keep my skin hydrated throughout the day. The tinted finish gives my skin a healthy, natural-looking glow and helps even out my complexion. It wears well under makeup and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy. Overall, it's a great everyday sunscreen that offers both protection and a beautiful skin-like finish.No strong smell blends like velvet no trace of white cast at all… *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Works great with or without makeup
avis.texte: I am quite pale so daily sunscreen is a must. I've tried a lot of mineral sunscreens that claim to work well under makeup, and this one has a pretty decent formula. The texture is very fluid and lightweight with a consistency that spreads easily across the skin without feeling heavy. While the formula appears tinted coming out of the bottle, it didn't really provide noticeable coverage on my skin. Instead, it gave a bit of a dewy glow but not in a shimmery way. I wore this both alone and under makeup, and it played very nicely with my other products. I didn't experience pilling, and makeup layered smoothly on top. The finish is definitely on the dewy side, especially when first applied, so those with oily skin will probably want to set it with powder. This didn't feel drying and I like how lightweight it feels. Overall this is a great way to get sun protection without a thick, heavy feel. *This product was received as part of an educational promotion. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Okay wait… I actually really love this product. Usually sunscreens make me greasy or break me out but this one didn't at all, even during my cycle. It sits so nice under makeup and gives the prettiest glow without feeling heavy. Definitely been reaching for this every morning lately. With summer coming I like to choose spf products or tinted spf and this one will be my number one this upcoming summer. A must buy! This picture is just the spf nothing else!This product was in exchange for a review *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: Good for light to medium skin tones

It is a lightweight, mineral only sunscreen meant to feel more like a moisturizer than a sunscreen. It is SPF 50, the highest for a mineral sunscreen. It is lightweight and feels more like a moisturizer than a sunscreen. It was lightweight and didn't make my skin feel greasy. *This review was collected as part of a promotion.

This barrier fluid spf 50 is fantastic it gives off the prettiest natural glow and instantly quenches the thirst of my dry skin. (Instantly super moisturizing) It has the slightest of tint that instantly blends into your skin. My skin looks and feels so much healthier and alive after using it.
